name: crm-companies-table
title: Company table
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Sortable, selectable company table with a logo, status, owner, pipeline value, score, and an activity sparkline. Sticky header, paged footer, and a CSV helper.

meta.descriptionEs: Tabla ordenable y seleccionable con logo, estado, responsable, valor, puntuación y una chispa de actividad. Encabezado fijo, pie con conteo y CSV.

examples.title: Cartera
examples.description: Doce empresas ficticias de Estudio Nube.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, vacío, cuarenta filas y un nombre sin espacios.

meta.usage:
<CrmCompaniesTable
  rows={companies}
  sort={sort}
  onSortChange={setSort}
  selectedIds={selectedIds}
  onSelectedIdsChange={setSelectedIds}
  onRowOpen={setCompany}
  formatValue={(value) => money.format(value)}
/>

api.name: rows
api.description: Companies to sort and page. The host owns the data.

api.name: sort / page / selectedIds
api.description: Omit them for internal state. Page size defaults to 8.

api.name: onExport
api.description: Receives the selection, or every sorted row when nothing is selected. Without it, the footer downloads companiesToCsv().

api.name: formatValue / csvLabels / labels
api.description: Locale and copy stay in the host. Defaults are English.

api.name: loading
api.description: Replaces the body with the loading label and disables the footer.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by github.com/kargulstudio/sales-crm, which publishes no license. No source, class names, colors, copy, or assets were copied. crm-table remains the fixed contact layout; this table is the company book and reuses Sparkline plus the CSV helper. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, badge, button, checkbox, or table. The item ships no theme. Column headers are buttons with aria-sort. The name stays sticky while the other columns scroll. With reduced motion the sparkline does not animate.
